goals.title: Production Telegram Mini App: anonymous adult content marketplace
goals.body: Research and plan a complete production-ready Telegram Mini App architecture for an OnlyFans-like adult content marketplace, starting with feet pics but expanding to broader categories (feet-only, custom content, full anonymity). Deliver feature research, architecture, security/compliance, and phased roadmap. Research and plan only — no implementation.

tasks.body: Research popular requests and patterns from OnlyFans/Fansly/ManyVids/Fanvue/LoyalFans and Telegram adult bots; feet niches; buyer/seller pain points; content models; prioritization P0/P1/P2

tasks.body: Investigate Telegram Mini Apps / Bot API / WebApp constraints: Stars payments, initData, WebApp SDK limits, media, live features, ToS for adult content

tasks.title: Redefine MVP as production-ready shippable bar

decisions.title: Payments: Stars-only inside Mini App
decisions.body: Use Telegram Stars (XTR) as the sole in-Mini-App payment rail for digital content (subs, PPV, tips, customs). Platform records ledger credits to sellers; operator withdraws Stars via Fragment→TON and pays sellers via Paxum/crypto/bank after KYC for payouts. Do not offer third-party card checkout inside the TMA for digital goods (violates Telegram/App Store rules and risks app invisibility). Optional Phase 2: external web portal for fiat only if legally separate and not linked as in-Telegram digital checkout.

decisions.title: Anonymity: public pseudonym + private seller KYC
decisions.body: Anonymity model: Pseudonymous public profiles (display name, avatar, no legal name). Buyers authenticate only via Telegram (no email/phone required by us). Sellers must complete private age/ID verification (encrypted vault, access-limited, never shown to buyers) before selling — industry/legal necessity for adult UGC. Buyers: hard 18+ attestation + progressive age-assurance where geo-law requires. Face-optional content encouraged for feet niche. EXIF/GPS strip on upload. Tradeoff accepted: absolute zero-KYC sellers is incompatible with responsible adult platform operation.

decisions.title: Product: feet-first expandable marketplace
decisions.body: Product model: Launch feet-first marketplace with expandable category taxonomy. Monetization: PPV + tips + escrowed customs in MVP; subscriptions/tiers and bundles in P1. Differentiation vs OnlyFans: native Telegram distribution, Stars micropayments without card forms, stronger anonymity UX, niche discovery (feet tags first), escrow-backed customs reducing scam culture of informal TG sales.

decisions.title: Security: initData, media, STRIDE, moderation
decisions.body: Security decisions: (1) Always validate initData with constant-time HMAC compare + auth_date TTL ≤1h for session mint. (2) Private object storage; signed URLs ≤5-15min; referer/token binding; no hotlinkable public media. (3) Visible + forensic watermarks with buyer_id hash. (4) Rate limits per telegram_id/IP on auth, upload, chat, checkout. (5) STRIDE: Spoofing→initData; Tampering→signed media tokens; Repudiation→immutable payment/moderation ledgers; Info disclosure→encrypt KYC vault, minimize PII; DoS→WAF/rate limits; Elevation→RBAC + admin MFA. (6) Moderation: async CSAM hash scan gate before publish; report queue; DMCA workflow; geo policy flags. No facilitation of illegal content.

decisions.title: Architecture: modular monolith + clear domains
decisions.body: Architecture decision: Modular monolith for MVP (API + bot worker + worker queues in one deployable with clear packages), extract media/moderation/payments services when scale requires. Prefer Fastify/NestJS + Postgres + Redis + R2 for speed-to-production. Schema-centric domains: users, creators, posts, media_assets, entitlements, subscriptions, orders/customs, tips, categories, reports, ledgers, kyc_vault.

decisions.title: MVP = production-ready launch bar (ops included)
decisions.body: MVP is redefined as the first public/closed-beta shippable product that can be operated safely in production. Must include: Telegram initData auth+sessions+RBAC, 18+ gate, seller private KYC, creator profiles, media pipeline (upload, EXIF strip, CSAM hash, watermark, signed URLs), PPV/tips/customs escrow, Stars invoice lifecycle, messaging+bot notify, feet categories/tags, block/report, moderation queue, FULL admin (MFA, KYC review, refunds, ledger ops, flags, audit), /terms+/paysupport, observability (logs/metrics/Sentry/alerts), backups, Dockerized VPS deploy with GitHub CI/CD, security baselines. Post-MVP: subscriptions, bundles, broader categories, live, ZKP, agencies, affiliates, forensic watermark v2, recommendations. Prior product decisions preserved: Stars-only, pseudonym+private KYC, feet-first, modular monolith.

decisions.title: VPS + Docker Compose scale-ready topology
decisions.body: Single VPS initially with Docker Compose for api, bot, worker, web, admin, postgres, redis, caddy/nginx. Object storage on R2/S3 (external). Scale path: (1) vertical VPS resize (2) horizontal api/bot/worker replicas behind reverse proxy (3) managed or separate Postgres/Redis hosts with volumes+backups (4) optional k8s later without app rewrite. Zero-downtime-ish via healthchecks + docker rollout / scale-then-drain. Secrets via env files on VPS + GH secrets; never in images.

decisions.title: GitHub Actions CI/CD with gated migrations
decisions.body: PR checks: lint, typecheck, unit, integration, build. Security: dependency audit, secret scanning (gitleaks), container Trivy. CD: build/push GHCR, SSH deploy compose pull + migrate (gated) + rolling restart; staging then prod environments. Migrations expand-contract; rollback = previous image tag + down migration only when safe (prefer forward-fix).

decisions.title: Observability: OTel Prometheus Grafana Sentry
decisions.body: Structured JSON logs with correlation/request IDs; audit logs for admin/mod/payments. Metrics via OpenTelemetry→Prometheus; Grafana dashboards; alerts for uptime, error rate, payment failures, queue depth, pre_checkout latency. Sentry for errors. Log retention tiers; KYC/PII redaction mandatory in app logs.

decisions.title: Testing strategy CI nightly pre-launch

discoveries.title: Core monetization loop across OF competitors
discoveries.body: Competitor platforms (OnlyFans, Fansly, Fanvue, LoyalFans) share a core monetization loop: subscriptions + PPV + tips + customs. Fees typically ~15-20%. Differentiation comes from tiered subscriptions (Fansly), discovery (Fansly For You / Fanvue Discover), AI messaging (Fanvue), video store/calls (LoyalFans). ARPU is driven by layering PPV/customs/tips on subscriptions, not subscription alone. Sources: heduno, influenceramerica, fans-alternative comparisons 2025-2026.

discoveries.title: Feet niche: escrow, anonymity, scam patterns
discoveries.body: Feet niche platforms (FeetFinder, Footly, Snifffr) emphasize: platform checkout/escrow, seller anonymity via display name with ID verification hidden from buyers, face-optional content, custom requests with prepayment, watermarked previews, weekly payouts via adult processors (CCBill/Paxum). Top scam vectors: off-platform move to Telegram/CashApp, fake payment screenshots, free proof pics. Marketplace value prop is trust + escrow vs free Telegram DMs. Sources: tryfootly, spicyranked FeetFinder review.

discoveries.title: Buyer and seller pain points prioritized
discoveries.body: Seller pain points (prioritized): unreliable/off-platform payments and chargebacks; doxxing risk (face/metadata/legal name); content leaks/screenshots; slow/opaque payouts; custom order disputes without escrow; discovery cold-start; verification that feels invasive. Buyer pain points: trust/scams; privacy; refund/dispute opacity; finding creators by niche tags; custom request friction; chat quality. Platform opportunity inside Telegram: meet users where they already message, but replace informal DM sales with verified escrow + Stars payments.

discoveries.title: Stars mandatory for digital goods in TMA
discoveries.body: Official Telegram docs (core.telegram.org/bots/payments-stars): Digital goods/services in bots and Mini Apps MUST use Stars (currency XTR) exclusively. Third-party fiat/crypto for digital goods inside Telegram apps risks hiding the Mini App from mobile users (Apple/Google IAP rules). Flow: sendInvoice(XTR) → pre_checkout_query (answer within 10s) → successful_payment → deliver; store telegram_payment_charge_id for refundStarPayment. Required: /paysupport, /terms. Crypto instead of Stars for in-app digital goods is explicitly disallowed.

discoveries.title: Workspace is empty greenfield
discoveries.body: Workspace /home/ali/Desktop/feet seller telegram app is greenfield: only .trace/ exists. No prior application code, docs, or configs. Architecture must be designed from scratch.

discoveries.title: Feature prioritization P0/P1/P2
discoveries.body: P0 (MVP must-have): Telegram auth via validated initData; 18+ age gate + seller age/ID verification (private); creator profiles (pseudonym); photo/video upload to private storage; free teaser + PPV unlock; tips; custom orders with Stars escrow (pay → deliver → release); buyer/seller in-app messaging; categories/tags starting with feet; report/block; Stars checkout + /paysupport;/terms; basic watermark on previews; admin moderation queue. P1: Subscriptions/tiers; bundles; scheduling; analytics; favorites/wishlist; recommendations; DMCA/leak takedown workflow; seller payouts ledger + Fragment withdrawal ops; geo soft-blocks; advanced anti-leak (forensic watermark). P2: Live/voice (if product allows via TG); multi-category expansion beyond feet; ZKP age proofs; affiliate; agency tools; multi-language; AI assist for sellers (non-CSAM).

discoveries.title: Telegram ToS: UGC moderation and illegal content
discoveries.body: Telegram ToS: illegal pornographic content prohibited on publicly viewable channels/bots; Bot Developer ToS requires SP to moderate all UGC, comply with local laws, and not facilitate illegal goods. Adult consensual content is not categorically banned by Telegram ToS text reviewed, but CSAM, NCII, trafficking, and illegal content are. Developer bears full moderation and legal liability; Telegram may intervene but is not obligated. Mini Apps share Telegram user id/name/username/photo/language/premium/theme — design must minimize further PII collection.

discoveries.title: TMA WebApp SDK constraints and capabilities
discoveries.body: WebApp SDK constraints (core.telegram.org/bots/webapps): Must validate initData server-side (HMAC-SHA256 with WebAppData+bot token); never trust initDataUnsafe. themeParams for native look. openInvoice for Stars payments from Mini App. MainButton/BottomButton, BackButton, HapticFeedback, CloudStorage, BiometricManager available. HTTPS required. Notifications primarily via Bot API messages, not arbitrary push. No native live streaming API in Mini Apps — live would need external WebRTC or TG channels/calls. Media delivery must be via own CDN/storage, not relying on Telegram file CDN for paid content.

discoveries.title: Stars fee stack and Fragment withdrawal
discoveries.body: Stars economics: Users buy Stars via Apple/Google (~30% store cut on mobile) or PremiumBot/desktop. Creators/bot owners withdraw earned Stars via Fragment to TON after 21-day hold, min ~1000 Stars, 2FA required. Effective creator take on mobile-sourced Stars often cited ~65-70% before platform fee. Platform should take a transparent cut (e.g. 10-20%) on top of Telegram economics and communicate net to sellers. Escrow for customs: hold entitlement until delivery confirmation or auto-release SLA.

discoveries.title: Age verification dual-track + CSAM pipeline
discoveries.body: Industry age-verification pattern for adult platforms: dual track — (1) creators: full ID/KYC for 2257-style recordkeeping and payment processor requirements, identity never shown to buyers; (2) buyers: privacy-preserving age assurance (attestation/ZKP/wallet) where legally required, else Telegram age gate + attestation. CSAM pipeline: hash matching (PhotoDNA/equivalent) before publish, NCMEC/local reporting where required, immutable moderation logs, human review for edge cases. Anonymity ≠ zero compliance.

discoveries.title: Recommended production component stack
discoveries.body: Frontend: React + Vite + TypeScript Telegram Mini App using @tma.js or official telegram-web-app.js; themeParams-driven UI; never trust client user id. Backend: Node (Nest/Fastify) or Go API gateway; validate initData HMAC; short-lived JWT/session bound to telegram_user_id; RBAC buyer|seller|moderator|admin. Bot worker: grammY/Telegraf for invoices, pre_checkout, successful_payment, notifications, /paysupport,/terms. Postgres primary + Redis cache/rate-limit/queues. Media: Cloudflare R2 or S3 private buckets; short-lived signed URLs; optional Cloudflare Stream for video; watermark service; no public listing of media keys. Realtime: Redis pub/sub or WebSocket for in-app chat; critical events also pushed via Bot messages. Admin: separate web panel with MFA. Deploy: Docker Compose → K8s; secrets in vault/SOPS; CI/CD lint/test/deploy; multi-env staging/prod. Observability: OpenTelemetry + structured logs + metrics + Sentry.

discoveries.title: Phased MVP to production roadmap
discoveries.body: Roadmap: Phase0 foundations 2-3w (legal, infra); Phase1 MVP 6-10w (PPV/tips/customs/messaging/Stars/moderation); Phase2 production 4-8w (subs, payouts, forensic WM, SLOs); Phase3 expand (categories, live, ZKP, i18n).

plan_changes.title: Architecture plan: TMA adult marketplace Stars-first
plan_changes.body: Recommended architecture plan: Feet-first anonymous adult marketplace as Telegram Mini App + Bot. Stack: React/Vite TMA, Nest/Fastify API, grammY bot, Postgres+Redis, private R2/S3 media with signed URLs and watermarks. Payments: Stars-only in-app; seller ledger; Fragment ops for withdrawal; platform fee 10-15%. Anonymity: public pseudonym + private seller KYC. MVP: auth, profiles, PPV, tips, escrow customs, messaging, moderation, feet tags. P1: subs, analytics, payouts, forensic WM. P2: broader categories, live, ZKP age. Modular monolith first. Full detail in docs/RESEARCH_ARCHITECTURE.md.

plan_changes.title: Production-ready MVP plan: scopes ops scaffold

Preserved: Stars-only, pseudonym+private KYC, feet-first, modular monolith, CSAM non-negotiable.

plan_changes.title: Subscriptions→MVP + glossary + skills matrix
plan_changes.body: Docs updated: PRODUCTION_MVP_PLAN, RESEARCH_ARCHITECTURE, GAPS G16–G22, ADR-002, GLOSSARY (Live/ZKP), SCOPES 06–09 + README waves, SKILLS_MATRIX (52 scopes), brainstorm spec, GRILLING_SESSION. No application code. Parent must continue grilling one question at a time.

plan_changes.title: Grilling closed: recommendations locked as MVP product decisions
plan_changes.body: Grilling Q1–Q13 locked via user directive (Q1=A; Q2–Q13=document recommendations). Decisions: sub-default feed + rare PPV; single tier launch (flag→1–3 flat replace); hard cut at Telegram expiry; schedule cut analytics then multi-tier; price change=archive+new tier; cancel=TMA+Telegram native; refunds=case-by-case admin runbook; renew tests=CI fixtures+one staging live sub/cancel; watermark visible+forensic flag; buyer age=attestation; counsel hard gate; fee same 10–15% as PPV; Live/ZKP/agencies out. Residual: G01/G13/G22 counsel execution.

plan_changes.title: Implementation plan supersedes design-only phase
plan_changes.body: Transition: approved design → implementation plan doc. Plan path docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-21-production-mvp-implementation.md. Waves 1–9 per SCOPES README; subs 06–09 in Wave 6; Wave 1 scaffold/ops only; G01 counsel parallel track. No monorepo code this turn.

plan_changes.body: PROCESS_PIR_LOOPS, TMA_LIVE_SMOKE, RESUME updated: local unit/integration/Playwright stub e2e is default until production-near; live Telegram + public tunnels deferred.

plan_changes.body: Optional backlog item opt (rename @feetapp to @spiced) promoted to Loop 97 by user choice (1) rename first then (2) product UI. This round is rename ONLY; product UI deferred to fresh agent.

claims.title: Stars-only for in-app digital goods
claims.body: Claim: In-Telegram digital content sales must use Stars.

claims.title: Claim: Stars-only XTR + 10s pre_checkout for digital goods
claims.body: Digital goods in Telegram bots/mini apps must use Telegram Stars (currency XTR). Flow: sendInvoice/createInvoiceLink → pre_checkout_query (answer within 10s) → successful_payment before delivery; store telegram_payment_charge_id for refunds. Third-party currencies for digital goods risk mobile app store hiding.

claims.title: Claim: GHCR + SSH compose rolling deploy is production pattern
claims.body: Production VPS deploy pattern: build/push images to registry (GHCR), SSH to host, docker compose pull, healthchecked rolling update (docker rollout or scale-then-drain), rollback via previous image tag. Requires reverse proxy and healthchecks; avoid published host ports on app replicas.

evidence.title: Official Stars digital goods requirement
evidence.body: Evidence from https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments-stars: 'Payments for digital goods and services must be carried out exclusively in Telegram Stars' and FAQ denying alternate currencies/crypto inside Telegram apps for digital goods.

evidence.title: Evidence: core.telegram.org bots/payments-stars
evidence.body: Official Telegram Bot Payments API for digital goods: https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments-stars — Stars/XTR mandatory; pre_checkout_query must be answered within 10 seconds; deliver only after successful_payment; store charge id for refunds.

evidence.title: Evidence: docker-rollout and GH Actions VPS deploy docs
evidence.body: docker-rollout / compose rolling patterns: https://github.com/Wowu/docker-rollout — scale service, wait healthy, remove old; requires proxy not host port mapping. Complementary guides: GH Actions SSH + compose pull deploy patterns (deploytovps / appleboy ssh-action ecosystem).

evidence.body: Verified loadRepoEnv + validateInitData path uses FEETAPP_BOT_TOKEN from env without logging secrets. Optional getMe smoke attempted via SOCKS 10808; results recorded without token values.

evidence.title: Loop 47: cloudflared http2 HTTPS serves web+/v1/health
evidence.body: cloudflared quick tunnel with --protocol http2 registered; public HTTPS served Spiced shell + /v1/health via Vite proxy. QUIC timed out; SOCKS on cloudflared broke registration. Ephemeral trycloudflare hostname — BotFather Menu Button still human. No secrets logged.

evidence.body: pnpm --filter @feetapp/web test: 17 passed; pnpm test (config+shared+api): green; pnpm test:e2e:local: 3 passed including status contrast ≥4.5. cloudflared stopped. No .env in Trace.
